# Anonymized native GeneratedType shape fixture

`native-root-generated-types.json` records the XML format version and the `GeneratedType` name prefixes and categories observed in one read-only descriptor from each available root-type folder in the local `FormatSamples/uh` sample. The inspected descriptors were format 2.20; the fixture has 44 canonical root types because two registry folders are absent from that sample.

The fixture intentionally contains no object names, UUIDs, descriptor paths, property values, namespaces, or business XML. It is an independent structural oracle for the explicit generated-type schema. It does not establish successful import, check, apply, export, or platform support beyond this sample shape.
